svg.title: JIANT FM · Navigation map · v0.3
svg.text: firmware v0.3 · six rules, one chain of pages per section

text.tspan: Ten buttons, ten sections. SELECT walks a section's pages as one chain; its button jumps group to
group.

svg.text: a tab = a group (the button jumps to the next one, round)
the line = SELECT's order, stops at both ends
dashed = only on the engines (or LOAD) that have it

text.tspan: TRACKS → VISUAL → GEN: HOME again (round) or
SELECT; HOME + SELECT straight to GEN. GEN 1–3:
PRESETS the genre, OCT+ makes the piece, OCT− back to
TRACKS.
PRESETS: the patterns (PHRASES). KNOB 1: all 64 steps on STEP (a fast turn several).
hold: ROOT on the keys
+ SELECT: walk this chain
KNOB 1 sets ROOT.

svg.text: ANALOG PHASE LOFI WHEEL VOICE ANIMAL …

text.tspan: TONE pages only where the engine has them: MORPH (ANALOG PHASE LOFI), RETRIG (LOFI), ROTOR (WHEEL), WORDS (VOICE). DRUM-X: KNOB 1 picks the kit's sound on SOUND.
CHORUS and SLICER are hidden with LOAD ECO; the chain skips them.
LIVE: MANO plays the modifiers on the keys. MIXER KNOB 4: the DJ
FILTER.
ALGORITHM picks the track on TRACKS.
KNOB 1: the slot on MOD, the step on MSEQ.
no layer
+ SELECT: walk
this chain
One group: ARP
inside goes back
to ARP.
From outside, USER and SECTIONS come with SAVE
armed: SAVE · OCT+ · OCT+.
One chain per section, a page a detent; it stops at the
first and the last. No levels, no zoom.
From elsewhere, the page you left there. Inside, the
first page of the next group, round.
The track's sounds everywhere, patterns in SEQ, the
genre in GEN. Never a page, a track or a module.
The step, the bar, the slot, the stage, the operator, the
kit's sound. The track is always ALGORITHM's.
A button held puts its shortcuts on the keys and
knobs; ALGORITHM while held: MAP · KNOBS · STATE.
Tabs on top: the groups, a dot a page. At the foot:
SECTION · GROUP · page and n/N.
the MENU: SCREEN · AUDIO · MIDI · USB · SYSTEM (SELECT the pages, ALGORITHM the tabs,
KNOB 1–4 the settings)
F3 INIT · G3 RECALL · DRUM: black keys 1–8 mute each sound
F3 CLEAR · G3 REVERSE · A3/B3 SHIFT · C4 RANDOM · D4 COOK · E4 BEAT · F4 CLR AUTO · D5
REVERT ·
G5 CLR STEP
· REC: CLEAR ALL
punch-in: F3–A3 REPEAT · B3 GLITCH · C4 TAPE STOP · D4/E4 OCT · F4 ½ TEMPO · G4/A4 DEC ·
B4/C5 STUTTER · D5–F5 ATK+ ARP RANDOM · G#4 FREEZE · C#5 SHUFFLE · D#5 F#5 sweeps ·
knobs: macros (a glitcher held: its own)
black 1–6 MUTE · F3–D4 SOLO · E4 unmute all · F4 TAP · A4 FREEZE · B4 REVERT ALL ·
G4 UNDO
PLAY restart · knobs: LEVEL
KNOB 1–4 = M1–M4, latched · F3 new routes · G3 clear
any key sets the ROOT
F3–B3 play A–D · C4–F4 store A–D ·
C5 NAME
· D5 LOOP/SONG · E5 SONG REC · G5 ARRANGE
F3 CLEAR · G3 CLICK
GEN, the song generator
their dice: BEFORE / NOW, keep or
cancel
the tempo, from any page
walk that chain from anywhere
the track, always
CLR STEP: the step and its locks
the EDIT page its knobs lock (SEQ ›
STEP)
NAME: rename the slot, section,
project
UNDO (again: redo)
back / do it (NO / YES)
